data.notes: May 2026 is unusually stacked in Berlin, pairing arena-scale pop and metal with heavyweight electronic gatherings, synth-culture programming, and long-form experimental festival formats.

events.title: ROSALÍA — LUX TOUR 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA brings her LUX TOUR 2026 to Berlin's Uber Arena for a major arena pop show on May 1.

events.title: WE ARE NOT ALONE May Day Weekender
events.summary: BPitch / We Are Not Alone returns to RSO.BERLIN for a May Day weekender across ROBUS, SUMME and OPAN, with Ellen Allien b2b SALOME, Helena Hauff, Bjarki, Matrixxman, Volvox, Nene H and more.

events.title: SUPERBOOTH26
events.summary: SUPERBOOTH26 is the 10th-anniversary edition of the Berlin trade fair and festival for electronic musical instruments, running May 7–9 at FEZ-Berlin with concerts, DJ sets, lecture concerts and workshops.

events.title: Out Of Line Weekender 2026
events.summary: The dark electronic and alternative festival returns to Astra Kulturhaus with acts including Kite, Aesthetic Perfection, Devision Redux, Ashbury Heights, Priest, Dina Summer, Reaper and Mildreda.

events.title: Klubnacht
events.summary: Berghain's May 9 Klubnacht features Planetary Assault Systems live, Altinbas, Amotik, Efdemin, Marcal and Paula Koski in Berghain, with Panorama Bar and Säule lineups including Kai Alcé, Massimiliano Pagliara and Hekt live.

events.title: Olivia Dean — The Art of Loving Tour
events.summary: Olivia Dean performs at Uber Arena on May 12 as part of her The Art of Loving tour.

events.title: Desertfest Berlin 2026
events.summary: Berlin's heavy rock, stoner, psychedelic, doom and sludge festival returns to Columbiahalle and Columbia Theater with The Sword, Truckfighters, Red Fang, YOB, Russian Circles, Pelican and more.

events.title: The Infinite Now
events.summary: Berlin Atonal and Unsound present a 30-hour continuous programme at Kraftwerk Berlin with Caterina Barbieri, Kali Malone, Adam Wiltzie, Eiko Ishibashi & Jim O'Rourke, Keiji Haino, Actress, Terrence Dixon and others.

events.title: TWICE — [THIS IS FOR] WORLD TOUR
events.summary: K-pop group TWICE brings the [THIS IS FOR] WORLD TOUR to Uber Arena on May 23.

events.title: Dub&Dal Festival 2026
events.venueName: MaHalla and secret location near Jannowitzbrücke
events.summary: Dub&Dal's three-day anniversary festival combines soundsystem culture, South Asian classical traditions, workshops and community programming, with Sarathy Korwar, Warrior Queen, MC Yallah, Roots Daughters, Perera Elsewhere and more.

events.title: Tresor meets Function
events.summary: Tresor hosts a Function-focused night with Function, Nastia Reigel and Sarah Wreath in Tresor, plus Jerome Sydenham and Robert Owens in Globus.

events.title: Metallica — M72 World Tour
events.summary: Metallica's M72 World Tour stops at Olympiastadion Berlin on May 30 for one of the month's largest stadium concerts.
